mentions.name: dc34-baogram
mentions.description: An image sharing app built for the DEF CON 34 badge that lets users share pictures they take, digitally signing each shared image so others can verify who took the photo. It also supports uploading arbitrary images from a computer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m attending defcon 34 and I vibe coded an image sharing app running on the badge https://github.com/zitterbewegung/dc34-baogram
